400 Bad Request when creating response with invalid model

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateResponseRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\CreateResponseRequest::from_json(json_encode(["input" => "Hello", "model" => "nonexistent-model"]));
try {
    LiterLlm::createResponse($req);
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo $error::class . ': ' . $error->getMessage() . "\n";
}
```
